documents.title: Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Uniparts India reported strong financial performance in Q1 FY27 with revenue growth of 27% and EBITDA growth of 55% year-on-year. Management highlighted that construction equipment demand remains robust while large agricultural equipment is at its cyclical bottom. The company maintains a strong net cash position of approximately INR190 crores and continues to evaluate inorganic acquisition opportunities. Furthermore, operations at the Mexico warehouse and the restoration of the Ludhiana finishing shop are progressing on schedule. Uniparts India reported Q1 FY27 revenue growth of 27% year-on-year to INR 3,552 Mn and PAT growth of 64% year-on-year to INR 566 Mn.

guidance.claim: Management stated that FY27 growth will be a couple of percentage points higher than the growth achieved in FY26.
guidance.quote: And keeping that in mind and the visibility that we have, our FY27 growth will be a couple of percentage points bigger than the growth that we had in FY26 on a year-on-year basis.

guidance.claim: Management expects warehousing sales to remain in the range of 52% to 56%.
guidance.quote: So over a period of time, I think our warehousing sales will remain in the range of, let's say, about 52% to 55%, 56%.

guidance.claim: Management expects the aftermarket segment to normalize and return to growth over the next 12 months.
guidance.quote: And I think over the next 12 months, we do expect this to normalize.

guidance.claim: Q1 FY27 performance aligned with quarter-on-quarter guidance and exceeded annual guidance.
guidance.quote: This performance is in line with the quarter on quarter guidance we had shared but better than the annual guidance we had given, and reflects the quality of execution by the team across a quarter that was not without its challenges.

guidance.claim: The company expects growth in FY27 to be in line with what it was in FY26.
guidance.quote: Overall, we do expect the growth in FY27 to be in line with what it was in FY26, supported by an improving industry cycle, execution of recent business rewards and wins and a gradual recovery across the end markets.

guidance.claim: North America's small agriculture segment is poised for approximately 5% growth in FY27.
guidance.quote: Overall, the segment is poised for approximately 5% growth in FY27, in line with industry estimates.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that leading OEMs indicate year 2026 represents the cyclical bottom for large agricultural equipment, with recovery expected through calendar year 2027.
demand_outlook.quote: Leading OEMs have indicated that current year 2026 represents the cyclical bottom with a more meaningful recovery expected through calendar year 2027.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that large agriculture is facing a mid-teens decline in the industry this year.
demand_outlook.quote: We expect mid-teens decline in the large ag industry this year.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that infrastructure-led spending is sustaining healthy customer schedules and order visibility in the construction equipment segment.
demand_outlook.quote: Infrastructure-led spending, particularly under the technology investments in the U.S. and the government-led investments in Europe, is sustaining healthy customer schedules and order visibility.

demand_outlook.claim: Management reported that the aftermarket business represented approximately 12% of revenue in Q1 of FY27 and was flat year-on-year in absolute terms.
demand_outlook.quote: Finally, our aftermarket business represents approximately 12% of revenue in Q1 of FY27 and was flat year-on-year in absolute terms.

demand_outlook.claim: Infrastructure investments in the US and government spending in Europe are supporting demand in construction equipment.
demand_outlook.quote: Infrastructure-led spending, particularly under the technology investments in the US and government led spending in Europe, is sustaining healthy customer schedules and order visibility.

demand_outlook.claim: Unit volumes in the Western small agriculture market are beginning to show recovery after three years of decline.
demand_outlook.quote: That said, the bottom appears to be behind us; after three consecutive years of volume declines, we are beginning to see some recovery in unit volumes, and the direction of growth is encouraging.

demand_outlook.claim: Leading OEMs indicate CY2026 is the cyclical bottom for large agriculture, with recovery expected in CY2027.
demand_outlook.quote: Leading OEMs have indicated that CY2026 represents the cyclical bottom, with a more meaningful recovery expected through CY2027.

demand_outlook.claim: Price volatility driven by tariffs caused customers to moderate purchasing in the aftermarket segment.
demand_outlook.quote: Tariff-driven price volatility has led to some demand skewing, as higher prices caused customers and channel partners to moderate their purchasing.

demand_outlook.claim: Customers commentary and industry data point to continued growth in FY27 for construction equipment in North America.
demand_outlook.quote: In North America, customers' commentary and industry data point to continued growth in FY27 for construction equipment, with demand expected to gradually strengthen through the year and the second half being better than the first half.

demand_outlook.claim: In Europe, the construction equipment market appears to have passed its cyclical low with early signs of recovery becoming more visible in quarter 4 of 26.
demand_outlook.quote: Specifically coming to Europe, the construction equipment market appears to have passed its cyclical low with early signs of recovery becoming more visible in quarter 4 of '26.

demand_outlook.claim: The small agriculture market in North America is on the path of recovery.
demand_outlook.quote: The small agriculture market in North America is on the path of recovery.

demand_outlook.claim: The European small agriculture market is showing early signs of stabilization after a prolonged period of softening.
demand_outlook.quote: In Europe, the small agriculture market is showing early signs of stabilization after a prolonged period of softening.

demand_outlook.claim: India's tractor industry demand remains stable.
demand_outlook.quote: And coming to India, the tractor industry demand remains stable, although we have to see how it reacts to the monsoons.

demand_outlook.claim: The large agricultural machinery sector continues to work through the current down cycle.
demand_outlook.quote: Let me talk about the large agricultural machinery, continues to work through the current down cycle with leading OEMs affirming that quarter 4 of '26 represents a cyclical trough.

capex_expansion.claim: Capital expenditure during the quarter was INR12 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Capital expenditure during the quarter was INR12 crores, in line with ongoing investment plans focused on capacity enhancement, productivity improvement and customer-led growth initiatives.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that Mexico operations are on track with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3 of this year.
capex_expansion.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3 of this year.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that the restoration of the finishing shop at the Ludhiana facility is progressing well and on schedule.
capex_expansion.quote: On that note, the restoration of the finishing shop at our Ludhiana facility is progressing well and on schedule.

capex_expansion.claim: Restoration of the Ludhiana finishing shop is progressing on schedule with no interruption to supply.
capex_expansion.quote: On that note, the restoration of the finishing shop at our Ludhiana facility is progressing well and on schedule, and I am pleased to report that customer supply has remained uninterrupted throughout.

capex_expansion.claim: First customer deliveries from the Mexico warehouse are expected in Q3.
capex_expansion.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track, with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex plans remain unchanged at about 2.5% to 3.5% of revenue.
capex_expansion.quote: Madhur, our capex plans remain unchanged at about 2.5% to 3.5% of our revenue, and that is consistent, and we will not be deviating from there.

margins_costs.claim: Cost of materials for the quarter was about 33.3% due to a product mix change.
margins_costs.quote: So Viraj, if you look at it, our cost of materials this time is about 33.3%, And I think it's coming at 33.3% largely because there's been a product mix change.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that material cost should typically be in the range of 34% to 37%.
margins_costs.quote: I think what we've always maintained is that our material cost should be in the range of 34% to 37%, and that's typical of our business.

margins_costs.claim: Management reaffirmed that cycle EBITDA margins are expected to be around 20%.
margins_costs.quote: So Mr. Jain, when we talk about 20% margins, we are talking about 20% margins over a cycle which is peak to trough.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA grew 55% year-on-year in Q1 FY27 alongside a 27% increase in revenues.
margins_costs.quote: Turning to Q1 FY27 performance we are pleased to report revenue growth of 27% year-on-year, EBITDA growth of 55% year-on- year and a PAT growth of 64% year-on-year.

margins_costs.claim: The ongoing West Asia situation has put pressure on input costs and supply chains.
margins_costs.quote: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.

margins_costs.claim: Uniparts delivered an EBITDA margin of 24% in quarter 4 FY26 and 22% for the full year FY26.
margins_costs.quote: A brief on the financial position for quarter 4 FY26, Uniparts delivered an EBITDA margin of 24% and 22% EBITDA margin for the full year FY26.

margins_costs.claim: The company has maintained conscious cost discipline throughout the year.
margins_costs.quote: Second, we have maintained conscious cost discipline through the year.

margins_costs.claim: The company stated that 20% EBITDA is sustainable over the cycle.
margins_costs.quote: We have said consistently that 20% EBITDA is sustainable over the cycle.

orders_capacity.claim: The trailing 12-month new business order book stands at over INR225 crores with a healthy pipeline.
orders_capacity.quote: On the business development front, our trailing 12-month new business order book remains robust at over INR225 crores with a healthy pipeline.

orders_capacity.claim: Trailing twelve-month new business order book stands at over INR 225 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: On the business development front, our trailing twelve-month new business order book remains robust at over INR 225 crore, with a healthy pipeline.

orders_capacity.claim: Trailing 12-month business wins exceeded INR225 crores, growing over 12.5% over quarter-on-quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: So if I talk about the strategic outlook, our new business momentum actually has gained meaningful traction with trailing 12-month business wins exceeding INR225 crores, growing over 12.5% over quarter-on-quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: New business awards were over INR225 crores in annualized potential over the last 12 months.
orders_capacity.quote: capex stands at INR12 crores for the quarter and the new business awards were over INR225 crores in annualized potential over last 12 months.

capital_allocation.claim: The net cash position at the end of quarter 1 stands at approximately INR190 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Our net cash position at the end of quarter 1 stands at INR190 crores, reflecting the continued strength of our cash generation.

capital_allocation.claim: Operating cash generated during the quarter was INR44 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: We generated INR44 crores of operating cash during the quarter, and our 12-month trailing EPS stands at INR39.97, reflecting sustained improvement in earnings over the past year.

capital_allocation.claim: Net cash position reached INR 190 crore at the end of Q1 FY27.
capital_allocation.quote: Our net cash position at the end of Q1 stands at INR 190 crore, reflecting the continued strength of our cash generation.

capital_allocation.claim: A special dividend of INR 101 crore was declared in October 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: To put this in context: when we declared the special dividend of INR 101cr in October 2025, our cash balance was approximately INR 210 crore.

capital_allocation.claim: Uniparts is actively evaluating acquisition opportunities to support its growth strategy.
capital_allocation.quote: Our balance sheet is in excellent health, and we continue to actively evaluate acquisition opportunities that can accelerate our strategic agenda.

capital_allocation.claim: The company continues to be net debt free with a net cash position of INR160 crores as of March 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: The cash flow remains strong, and the company continues to be net debt free with a net cash position of INR160 crores as on March 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: The total dividend distributed for FY26 was INR170 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: During Q3 of FY26, the company declared a special dividend of INR101 crores. In fact, the total dividend distributed for FY26 was INR170 crores, underscoring our commitment to disciplined capital allocation and shareholders' return.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management stated that the ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.
risks_headwinds.quote: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.

risks_headwinds.claim: Tariff-related price volatility created demand skewing in the aftermarket segment.
risks_headwinds.quote: Tariff-driven price volatility has led to some demand skewing, as higher prices caused customers and channel partners to moderate their purchasing.

risks_headwinds.claim: Towards the end of quarter 3, one of the facilities in Ludhiana experienced a fire incident in the finishing shop.
risks_headwinds.quote: As communicated previously, towards the end of quarter 3, one of our facilities in Ludhiana experienced a fire incidents in the finishing shop.

risks_headwinds.claim: In March, a fresh escalation in West Asia introduced supply chain uncertainty that required swift action.
risks_headwinds.quote: In March, a fresh escalation in West Asia introduced supply chain uncertainty that required swift action.

risks_headwinds.claim: The evolving geopolitical situation has resulted in increasing input prices, though mitigated by favorable exchange rates.
risks_headwinds.quote: While the evolving geopolitical situation has resulted in increasing input prices, some of this inflation is being mitigated by favourable exchange rates.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the fabrication vertical will become a meaningful vertical within 18 to 24 months.
management_commitments.quote: In the next 18 to 24 months, we believe this vertical will be a meaningful vertical.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets acquisitions to be ROCE and ROE accretive within an 18 to 30-month span.
management_commitments.quote: We're also looking at something which is ROCE and ROE accretive to us within, let's say, an 18 to 30-months span.

management_commitments.claim: First customer deliveries from the Mexico warehouse are expected in Q3.
management_commitments.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track, with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects normal operations of the Ludhiana facility to return on schedule.
management_commitments.quote: We expect normal operations to return on schedule.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
